verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Both conjuncts are stated, each in an integrated rather than infinitesimal form. ∂_θ a = 0 appears as `Invariant`, f (x + t • θ) = f x: for the smooth fields at issue the two are equivalent, since ∂_θ f = 0 along the (connected) θ-line integrates to constancy and conversely differentiating the invariance at t = 0 gives ∂_θ f = 0; `invariant_eq_zeroSlice` is the same statement in the form f (p,t) = f (p,0), and `periodizedGaussian_eq` exhibits it for the constructed Gaussian. supp(a|_{ℰ_γ}) ⊂ Ω_γ appears as `NonzeroSupportedOn U K c`, which is literally the contrapositive, x ∈ U \ K → c j x = 0, with U for ℰ_γ and K for the carrier; `coefficient_nativeSupport_of_field` states it for the constructed coefficients. The `j ≠ 0` guard in `NonzeroSupportedOn` is not a restriction here: in the paper m ranges over ℋ_j ⊂ ℤ \ {0}, so the zero mode is excluded on both sides.
